metadata.title: Culinary Canvas - National Workshop on Food Service Enterprises 2024@KudumbashreeKerala, Trivandrum
metadata.description:
Anubhav was honoured to be invited to the National Workshop on Food Service Enterprises jointly organized by the Ministry of Rural Development and Kudumbashree NRO in Trivandrum, Kerala between 15th-17th of January, 2024.

The primary objectives of the workshop were to understand the scope and impact of food service enterprises for Self-Help Group (SHG) entrepreneurs under the National Rural Livelihood Mission. Additionally, there was a focus on developing cross-learning opportunities and partnerships with various agencies and states to promote food service enterprises. 

The workshop featured a diverse lineup, including panel discussions, dialogues with experts and mission directors, exhibitions showcasing platforms and technologies for food service enterprises and a vibrant Food Street highlighting the culinary flavors of Kerala.

Anubhav's role involved speaking on the branding and marketing session, focusing on understanding the dynamics of branding agencies, effective marketing strategies, and showcasing successful branding strategies in the food service sector. The discussions also delved into exploring diverse marketing strategies implemented for food service.

Amid the enriching sessions, participants had the chance to savor authentic Kerala cuisine and witness Kudumbashree mission's impactful Café Kudumbashree program. The event facilitated interactions with inspiring food entrepreneurs, allowing for a firsthand taste of their delicious homestyle menus.

The experience extended ended with a delightful boat ride through the backwaters of Poovar and a relaxing time at the beach, adding a touch of enjoyment to the overall insightful and engaging event.

The video brings you a highlight from this enriching event.
